consequence.statement: Existing ClusterCleanupPolicy objects stay stored as v2beta1 after the CRD storage version moves to v2. They must be rewritten (storage version migration) and status.storedVersions updated before a later release removes v2beta1.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, rewrite all ClusterCleanupPolicy objects so they are stored as v2. Then remove v2beta1 from status.storedVersions on the clustercleanuppolicies.kyverno.io CRD.

assertion.statement: From 1.12.6 to 1.13.0, the storage version of the clustercleanuppolicies.kyverno.io CRD moves from v2beta1 to v2, so existing ClusterCleanupPolicy objects need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before v2beta1 is removed in a later release.
